line.name: Brick House
line.description: Not on the site at all - the site's J.C. Newman entry lists only El Reloj, The American, and Yagua. Founded on a story from J.C. Newman founder Julius Caesar Newman, who named the brand after a communal Hungarian gathering house. Discontinued during the Depression, revived by descendants Bobby and Eric Newman using Cuban-seed tobacco grown in Nicaragua. Made at J.C. Newman's PENSA factory in Esteli, Nicaragua - a value-priced line, unrelated to the separately-owned HVC brand despite a superficial naming resemblance some might assume.
